data.body: Implemented both DSH-parity fixes, pushed as 8248eee (CoT passback) and b207144 (image dispatch). CoT: ModelAssistantContentV1 gained Reasoning{text}; ProjectionBuilder retains raw reasoning (never a summary) from channel=reasoning deltas into the exchange; openai_tool_request emits reasoning_content; anthropic/gemini skip it; compaction Unit::tokens counts it. Image: ImageDispatchV1 on FrozenModelGateway, set per run by compaction::image_dispatch(model_context) from the frozen imageInput capability the image tools already use; reference mode reads no bytes and describes every image; attached mode keeps the newest 16 images / 24 MiB and degrades older ones to references. Tests green: capability host 169 lib + 4 provider_images, desktop compaction 27. NOT yet verified live: the desktop bundle predates both fixes, so the expected recovery (104,453 uncached tokens on reasoning-flip turns; ~1.2 MB/turn of image upload) is unmeasured.
